description: This file defines a class 'ConfigFileWatcher' that is responsible for monitoring a specific configuration file and its directory for changes. It uses a file watching mechanism to invoke a callback when relevant files are modified.

classes.name: ConfigFileWatcher
classes.description: A class that watches a specific configuration file for changes and triggers a callback.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes a ConfigFileWatcher instance with a URL and an onChange callback, setting up a file watcher for the directory and filtering relevant events.
